items.name: Confirm launch goals
items.description: Align stakeholders on the target audience, launch outcomes, and decision owners.

items.name: Approve product positioning
items.description: Finalize the value proposition and supporting messages for launch channels.

items.name: Finalize landing page
items.description: Complete copy, product visuals, analytics events, and stakeholder review.

items.name: Prepare launch announcement
items.description: Draft email and social copy, then schedule the approved campaign.

items.name: Complete release QA
items.description: Validate critical user journeys, accessibility, and launch-day monitoring.

items.name: Review launch metrics
items.description: Compare activation, adoption, and quality results with launch targets.

items.name: Synthesize beta feedback
items.description: Summarize recurring feedback, resolved blockers, and accepted follow-up work.

items.name: Prepare support playbook
items.description: Document common questions, escalation paths, and launch-day support coverage.

items.name: Build launch-day dashboard
items.description: Track adoption, reliability, and support signals in one shared launch view.

items.name: Schedule launch retrospective
items.description: Invite the launch team and capture topics for the post-launch review.
